focus: Independently corroborate the Binance XRPL native-XRP outflow with Bitquery; extend the observed attacker-address cutoff to 03:54 UTC; reconcile the later Binance deposit/withdrawal status, PoR-wallet labeling and conflicting XRP ETF daily flows; correct the sharded-ledger validator's v3 index-format assumption and verify exact-head PR checks.

binance_official.loss_coverage: Binance says SAFU and company funds will cover all losses; no audited postmortem or updated PoR in this capture.
binance_official.attack_vector: Initial company account: compromised DevOps engineer laptop/service container; no evidence of wallet private-key leak.

attribution.trm: TRM attributes TraderTraitor / North Korea with high confidence based on on-chain and off-chain intelligence.
attribution.chainalysis: Reuters reports Chainalysis also attributed the incident to North Korea.
attribution.independent_confirmation_limit: Bitquery independently traces public-chain transfers but does not independently establish the North Korea attribution.

xrp.bitquery_receiver_state: 233.5M XRP remained; receiver had not sent a transaction since the drain.
xrp.freezeability: Native XRP has no issuer-level freeze/blacklist control; custodial venues may separately restrict their own accounts.
xrp.cross_chain_linkage: Bitquery says XRP and Solana drains share no address with other incident chains; they are linked by timing, unusual transaction construction and Binance's own aggregate incident total.

scope_reconciliation.reason_for_difference: Public reports use different chain coverage; Bitquery's nine-chain summary omits at least one chain listed by TRM. Do not combine their incident totals without a chain-by-chain crosswalk.

rlusd.reconciliation: 40.5M RLUSD freeze is on-chain confirmed by TRM; the broader ~$200M Ripple assistance statement is not fully reconciled to token-level composition.

proof_of_reserves.bitquery_method: Bitquery says each drained wallet carries a Binance proof-of-reserves label in its address data.
proof_of_reserves.coindesk_crosscheck: CoinDesk identifies Binance 14 (Ethereum) in the Oct 1 PoR set and estimates ETH coverage could fall near 94% until replenishment.

incident_scale_ratios.qualification: Illustrative ratios only; five stolen wallets have not been crosswalked to the XRP Insights labeled-wallet universe, and labeled balances include cold storage/reserves rather than available order-book supply.

tradradar.scope: 7 exchanges for OI; 5 for liquidation and account ratio.

market_panel.limitation: No later synchronized XRP spot/perpetual panel was verified in this capture. Account ratios are not notional exposure; liquidation totals are provider/venue-scope dependent.

xrp_insights_oct28.universe: 6 spot funds plus BITW; GXRP excluded from flow sum while holdings count

etf_flow_reconciliation.reconciliation: Not comparable as same-day totals: different fund universes, issuer-file settlement cutoffs and GXRP treatment. No ETF-flow feature admitted.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 233.46M native XRP at an attacker-controlled XRPL receiver is a latent future supply/liquidity overhang if later sold, bridged or deposited to a venue.
support: Bitquery independently observes about 233.5M XRP still at the receiver at 03:54 UTC
counter: No receiver transaction after the drain through Bitquery's 03:54 cutoff
No sale, exchange deposit, mixer or bridge observed through that cutoff
Native XRP is not issuer-freezable, but no liquidation is observed

competing_hypotheses.claim: The attack created asset-specific PoR coverage risk because drained wallets were PoR-labelled; the risk may persist until replenishment is demonstrated.
support: Bitquery says all drained wallets carry Binance PoR labels
CoinDesk identifies Binance 14 in Oct 1 PoR and estimates ETH coverage could be near 94% before replenishment
counter: Binance says SAFU and company funds cover all losses and user funds are safe
No current XRP-specific reserve ratio or liability denominator has been recomputed
PoR snapshots and customer liabilities can change; freezes/recoveries/replenishment remain evolving

competing_hypotheses.claim: Some users may shift custody/trading from Binance to Coinbase after withdrawals reopen, potentially changing XRP venue balances and basis.
support: Coinbase has substantial labeled XRP custody wallets and broad distribution
counter: No measured Binance-to-Coinbase XRP transfers or customer migration
Coinbase's 5.84B labeled XRP is not proprietary inventory
Coinbase shares fell in the initial market reaction; status-page silence does not prove zero indirect impact

competing_hypotheses.claim: Current Oct 29 XRP ETF flow headlines are dominated by asynchronous reporting and different fund universes rather than a reconciled daily capital-flow measure.
support: XRP Insights reports Oct 28 +174.14K XRP and Oct26-28 -2.96M XRP on a different universe
counter: Issuer-level holdings files can resolve differences once all are published and aligned
Some apparent differences may be timing rather than methodology
